market.question: Will US crude oil reserves fall to 275M by June 5?

assessment.reasoning: SPR stood at 405,045 thousand barrels for week ending April 17, 2026. To reach 275M by June 5 would require a ~130M drawdown in ~7 weeks (~18.5M/week), but recent weekly drawdowns are only ~4M/barrel. Even with the coordinated release, this pace cannot reach 275M before June 5. Essentially physically impossible without an unprecedented release.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether DOE announces an unprecedented emergency drawdown
